editorial:
Imagine getting a job that seems like a dream for any actor. You get hired to play a monster in a scary haunted house attraction, but the catch is that you have to live in the house for a while. You and your fellow actors think it is all just a big game to make the experience feel real for the guests. The vibe starts off as a fun, creepy roleplay, but you quickly realize that the owner of the house is not playing a character. The atmosphere gets tense fast as you notice things in the building that should not be there, and the prank starts to feel way too real for comfort.

What really works here is how the tension builds up. The acting is solid, and the twists keep you guessing about who is actually in danger. While some parts feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it for any horror fan. If you are into stories where people are trapped in a bad situation, you will love this. You can find it by renting on Apple TV or streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: You find out that the house owner is actually a killer who uses the haunted house as a cover to kidnap and kill people. The actors realize they were never hired for their talent, but were chosen as new victims. In the end, the survivors have to fight their way out of the maze. Most of the cast dies, but a few manage to escape the house just as it becomes a real crime scene.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves trapped-room thrillers and creepy houses.
